cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell the children about tomorrow's operation after tea. Stay while I get the words straight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then no more tea. I'll practise on you once before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without stopping. Then you can go, and I'll tell them.
